Refstream.js 0.1.0-alpha.4

Serve all files together, including chunks/.
Load refstream.css plus refstream.js as an ES module, or
refstream.global.js as a classic script and use Refstream.Terminal.
Optional UI: ui.js and ui.css. Optional file streams: files.js.
Persistent handoffs and their limits: docs/agents.md.
API: https://github.com/TeoSlayer/refstream.js
